## SECR Package
Spatially Explicit Capture Recapture

Estimate the density and size of spatially distributed animal populations from detector arrays via passive acoustic monitors (PAMs), using maximum-likelihood SECR models.
Tools are included for data manipulation and model selection.
SECR models the locations of detections and the histories of marked animals, allowing you to estimate population density and to fit a model to show how probability declines with distance from each detector, including spatial/temporal trends.

Detection functions describe how the probability of being detected a a given detector declines with distance from animals activity centre, most commonly used is HalfNormal (HN). 

::: {.callout-note}
The **secr** R package assumes the population is *closed* during the sampling period so no animals move out of the area - no births, deaths, immigration or emigration occurs (). 
:::

- 1 First install from CRAN: install.packages("secr")
- 2 Load package: library(secr)
- 3 List all available detection functions: ?detectfn
